references.text: Moses placed the staffs before the Lord in the tent of testimony, which was the original instruction before the staffs were taken out.
The preceding context where the tribes gave their staffs and Aaron's staff budded, leading Moses to take out all the staffs.
Aaron's staff that turned into a snake before Pharaoh shows the staff's significance as a sign of divine authority.
The list of tribal leaders who represented each tribe, in the same way that each tribe's staff represented them.
Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron's leadership, which was the background for the staff test that confirmed Aaron's selection.
Hebrews mentions Aaron's staff that budded as part of the ark of the covenant, confirming the staff's enduring significance as a testimony.
